package architecture

import (
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"io/fs"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDomainAndApplicationUseRuntimePortsInsteadOfServiceTransports(t *testing.T) {
	coreRoots := []string{"../domain", "../application"}
	for _, coreRoot := range coreRoots {
		err := filepath.WalkDir(coreRoot, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
			if walkErr != nil {
				return walkErr
			}
			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".go") || strings.HasSuffix(path, "_test.go") {
				return nil
			}
			file, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), path, nil, parser.ImportsOnly)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for _, spec := range file.Imports {
				importPath, err := strconv.Unquote(spec.Path.Value)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if forbiddenRuntimeCoreImport(coreRoot, importPath) {
					t.Errorf("%s imports concrete service or transport dependency %q", path, importPath)
				}
			}
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("inspect %s imports: %v", coreRoot, err)
		}
	}
}

func forbiddenRuntimeCoreImport(coreRoot, importPath string) bool {
	for _, prefix := range []string{
		"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner",
		"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-student",
		"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-sandbox",
		"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-validation-orchestrator",
		"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-pet-project-orchestrator",
		"github.com/example/ms-practice-task-orchestrator-service",
		"net/http",
		"database/sql",
		"github.com/jackc/pgx",
		"/internal/infrastructure/",
		"/internal/transport/",
	} {
		if strings.HasPrefix(importPath, prefix) || strings.Contains(importPath, prefix) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return coreRoot == "../domain" && strings.Contains(importPath, "/internal/application/")
}
